stem: If a polynomial p(x) is divided by x - c, what is the remainder?
solution_latex: According to the Remainder Theorem, if a polynomial $p(x)$ is divided by $x-c$, the remainder is $p(c)$. This is derived from the division algorithm $p(x) = (x-c)q(x) + r$, where $q(x)$ is the quotient and $r$ is the remainder. Substituting $x=c$ gives $p(c) = (c-c)q(c) + r = 0 + r = r$.
